basics.name: Adnan Abbas
basics.label: CS PhD Student @ Virginia Tech
basics.summary: A Human–Computer Interaction (HCI) researcher exploring how conversational and agentic AI systems can support productivity, self-reflection, and collaboration. My work investigates how people engage with large language model–driven agents for planning and behavior change, and how such systems shape social interaction, cooperation, and collective knowledge practices in the workplace.

work.name: Virginia Tech — Echolab
work.summary: HCI research on agentic conversational support for planning and reflection; end-to-end system design, deployment, and mixed-methods evaluation.
highlights: Reviewed 100+ papers on human–AI interaction and behavioral science to surface design and analysis gaps.
Engineered and field-deployed a Slack-based agent promoting diverse productivity interventions.
Ran a two-week mixed-methods field study (N=12) using interviews, conversation logs, and daily surveys.
Conducted qualitative (open/thematic coding, dialogue-act analysis) and quantitative analyses (Python/R).

work.name: Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS)
work.summary: Systems research on edge-based cellular control planes.
highlights: Co-developed a design for optimizing control-plane operations; geographically aware consistent hashing.
Improved latency-sensitive application performance by up to ~2.8× under real-world cellular traffic.
